LESSON: SCALE DRAWING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry 4.1 Coordinates and Graphs 6
Topic 4.2: Scale Drawing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Scale Drawing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this

1. solve questions on Scale Drawing
2. show clear working for Scale Drawing

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Learning Scale Drawing

• Read the meaning of Scale Drawing.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Scale Drawing

Teach
• Use objects, drawings, or place value to understand Scale Drawing.
• Write each step. Box the final answer.

Worked example
• Model question on Scale Drawing: write the question.
• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …
• (Your teacher/parent can replace this with the class example.)

Try this
• Invent 3 Scale Drawing questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Scale Drawing question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Scale Drawing.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a revision sheet for Scale Drawing with 5 worked examples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Show working.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
